requests.readback: Bind created_ruleset_id only from actual response and GET; compare supported request fields and explicit server defaults; no invented identifier.

requests.precondition: Ref absent and empty-main SHA freshly verified; never replace existing ref.

requests.name: detach-production-from-main
requests.readback: Compare every other request-owned field to fresh snapshot; modified_on may change as server metadata and must be recorded explicitly. Verify queues and unchanged production version; unexpected build stops main writes.

requests.name: retarget-existing-dev
requests.precondition: Production detached/protected; main still verified empty.
requests.readback: Compare every other request-owned field to fresh snapshot; record expected modified_on change explicitly, reject other unexplained metadata drift. Preserve existing Worker/state/commands/filters/associations; inspect both queues and versions.

requests.readback: UUID bound to actual observed build, cancellation request followed by terminal status readback; otherwise stop.
